(b) Dropping nonnegativity: the deepest level is forced to +- delta_{y0} by an autocorrelation argument (finite exponential sum vanishing on an open set), the ladder W_j = -eps S_{y0} reflect(W_{J-2-j}) holds at every J, the J = 3 lossless region is exactly the closed deltoid |b|^4 + 18|b|^2 - 8 Re(b^3) - 27 <= 0 (both directions symbolic), and the gain-one three-level rule factors as a blinking branch at lam = -1 plus a wave pair with window [-3, 1]. (c) Two exact identities give cone radii exactly 1/sqrt(d) and 1/sqrt(2d) on Z^d though the spectrum is not a function of |k|, and Cayley-Hamilton plus the autocorrelation argument give det U(k) = c e^{-i k.y0} for any finite-range unitary amplitude rule, so the signed weight is -det U, i.e. unitarity rather than a probability. check.py: 41 ok, 0 BAD, exit 0.
what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 4 of 5: Probabilities diffuse; what is the smallest departure that propagates?. GIVEN (refereed): a gain-one linear formation law with one level of memory and nonnegative predecessor weights is drift plus diffusion, never a wave (|lambda(k)| <= 1 with equality only on a sublattice set; lambda = 1 - i mu.k - (1/2) k^T (Sigma + mu mu^T) k + ...). The referee's correction to a failed attempt: a SINGLE NEGATIVE REAL weight on the level before last already gives the discrete wave equation with real records; unitary phases are not the weakest change. TASK: (a) the multi-level theorem: with nonnegative weights over finitely many earlier levels, no branch of the dispersion relation has |lambda(k)| = 1 on an open set (prove it, or find the exception); (b) classify the minimal signed rules that do propagate: theta_{t+1} = 2a P theta_t - theta_{t-1} and relatives: dispersion, stability region, the speed; (c) the question for the axiom: overlap weights are probabilities of records, so a negative weight is not a probability. What formation rule on AMPLITUDES (complex record amplitudes combined by a unitary local rule, probabilities by the squared modulus at readout) reproduces the signed recursion for the amplitude and what does it give for the record statistics? Work the smallest example exactly (two-component amplitude on the 1+1 event lattice: the unitary nearest-neighbour rule and its dispersion) and state what is kept and what is lost relative to the positive formation law (order-independence, the Green-function static kernel, reversibility). ROUND 2: the first round's attempts and referee reports are under probes/work/derive/<problem>/ and logs/probes/J:derive:*/ and logs/probes/J:confirm:J-derive-*/ (python3 probes/harvest.py lists them); what survived refereeing is stated below as GIVEN, what failed is stated as the gap. DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/waves-need-signed-weights/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. ATTEMPT.md: (1) the exact statement you attempt; (2) numbered steps, each marked PROVED (argument given in full), CHECKED (a finite fact check.py verifies exactly) or ASSUMED; (3) if the route fails, the FIRST step that fails and why: a precise no-go for a route is a result; (4) what would finish it. check.py: exact arithmetic (fractions, integers, sympy) for every finite claim; it prints `SUMMARY: PROVED ...`, `SUMMARY: COUNTEREXAMPLE ...`, `SUMMARY: PARTIAL <what is new and exact>` or `SUMMARY: ROUTE FAILS AT <step>`, and a line `HIT: <the claim>` ONLY when you claim a proof, a counterexample, or a new exact partial result others can build on; a HIT is handed to a worker of another model family to referee line by line, so write for a hostile reader. Rules: definitions come from the notes on the PR branches named above (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; find them with gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName); any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route.
